responsibility: Implements the diagnostics-facing source-location and source-file support layer built around line maps and a small file cache. It owns global line_table/input_location state, special built-in filename handling, source-file rereading with optional charset conversion and BOM skipping, cached line lookup and full-file access for diagnostic rendering, and column/UTF-8 utility behavior needed by rich-location printing and location expansion.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the input stem pair: it owns the global line_table/input_location state, file-cache machinery, source rereading, charset/BOM handling, and location/text lookup behavior, whereas input.h primarily publishes the location macros, types, globals, and APIs used elsewhere.
